A CSRF token mismatch means the token sent with your request no longer matches the one tied to your session.

Nine times out of ten the token is fine and the session is the culprit: it expired, its cookie got blocked, or a load balancer minted the token on a different node. Diagnose the session first, not the code.

Quick thread 🧵
A CSRF token mismatch means the token sent with your request no longer matches the one tied to your session.
Nine times out of ten the token is fine and the session is the culprit: it expired, its cookie got blocked, or a load balancer minted the token on a different node.
Diagnose the session first, not the code.
